acceptance_2_unavailable_and_degraded_su.reason_translator: translateDataSourceSurfaceReason & translateDataSourceSurfaceStatus in src/management/pages/oversight/dataSources/dataSourceModels.ts using reasonCodeLabel & statusLabel from src/lib/enumLabels.ts (FE-MGMT-LABELS-AND-RAW-VALUES-20261120)
acceptance_2_unavailable_and_degraded_su.header_behavior: When the BFF reports the data-source surface unavailable or degraded, the header renders the translated state badge (data-sources-header-state: 不可用（無法讀取） / Unavailable or 降級 / Degraded) and the translated reason (data-sources-header-reason: e.g. 原因：上游讀取逾時 / Reason: Upstream read timed out). The header MetricCards never display 0 or 0/0 when the surface is unavailable or degraded; 0 and 0/0 are shown only when the BFF returned a successful empty list (isAuthoritativeEmpty).
acceptance_2_unavailable_and_degraded_su.table_behavior: DataSourceInstancesTable renders instances-table-surface-status and instances-table-empty-row showing the surface state and translated reason alongside the data-sources-unavailable and degraded-legacy-banner cards.

labelled_locations: Header badge (data-testid='data-sources-header-source'): 舊版相容投影 (legacy_projection) / Legacy projection (legacy_projection) rendered only when surfaceState.isLegacyProjection is true

Degraded banner (data-testid='degraded-legacy-banner'): renders 舊版相容投影模式 / Legacy Compatibility Projection Mode + legacy_projection badge when surfaceState.isLegacyProjection is true, and generic 資料源表面降級 / Data Source Surface Degraded copy when degraded with a non-legacy source (e.g. service_client)
Table surface status bar (data-testid='instances-table-surface-status'): 降級 + 舊版相容投影 (legacy_projection) (only when legacy_projection) + translated reason
Table row Support / Deployment badge: legacy_projection on both LegacyDataSourceRow and V2DataSourceRow when source=legacy_projection

acceptance_4_nan_free_models_and_missing.sanitization: adaptDataSource in src/lib/bff-v1/managementConsoleReads.ts preserves explicit provider/name/display_name provenance (falling back to 'unknown' rather than copying connector_id or providerKey when provider is missing); cleanSourceToken strips undefined, null, empty strings, nan, and adapter missing sentinels ('unknown', 'unknown-source', 'unknown_source') without discarding real source-N/connector-N identifiers; resolveLegacyProviderKey and resolveLegacyProviderLabel detect synthetic data-source-N placeholders and render 未回報 when provider is missing while preserving explicit providers even when provider equals connector_id or in provider-only responses.
acceptance_4_nan_free_models_and_missing.verified_fallbacks: personaSourceRecord, fallbackPersonaSourceRecord, personaDataSourceRecords, v2ToLegacyRecord, V2DataSourceRow, LegacyDataSourceRow, and PersonaDataSourceRow fall back to 未回報 for missing, nan, or adapter-synthesized provider and lifecycle/health/reconciliation/credential/definition status while preserving authoritative V2 source_instance_id/connector_id routing targets.
